candidate_sentences.text: The management confirmed no impairment indicators for the Klaipėda terminal assets during the reporting period.

verified_key_information_units.information: The Group reported revenue of EUR 29.8 million for the three months ended 31 March 2026, increasing from EUR 25.3 million in the same period of 2025. The Company reported revenue of EUR 28.7 million, up from EUR 24.3 million. Group net profit rose to EUR 7.2 million from EUR 4.4 million; Company net profit increased to EUR 6.8 million from EUR 4.0 million.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Consolidated and Separate Statements of Comprehensive Income (page 4)

candidate_sentences.text: AB KN Energies reported consolidated revenue of EUR 29,823 thousand for the three months ended 31 March 2026, an increase of 17.8 percent compared to EUR 25,326 thousand in the same period of 2025.

Following income tax expenses of EUR 1,577 thousand, net profit reached EUR 7,247 thousand, a 63.7 percent increase over EUR 4,426 thousand, with basic earnings per share improving to EUR 0.02 from EUR 0.01.

verified_key_information_units.information: The LNG terminal (LNGT) segment generated revenue of EUR 18.7 million in Q1 2026, a 25% increase compared with EUR 14.9 million in Q1 2025.

candidate_sentences.text: Revenue growth was driven by the LNG terminal segment, which rose 24.7 percent to EUR 18,687 thousand, and the commercial LNG segment, which grew 35.7 percent to EUR 3,357 thousand.

verified_key_information_units.information: The liquid energy terminals (LET) segment revenue decreased to EUR 7.8 million for the period ended 31 March 2026 from EUR 7.9 million in the comparable period of 2025.

candidate_sentences.text: The liquid energy terminals segment experienced a marginal decline of 1.1 percent to EUR 7,779 thousand.

verified_key_information_units.information: Commercial LNG (comLNG) segment revenue grew to EUR 3.4 million for Q1 2026 from EUR 2.5 million in Q1 2025, supported by activities of subsidiaries in Brazil and Germany.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Operating Segments analysis, Note 4 (page 8) and General Information, Note 1.2 (page 7)

candidate_sentences.text: Revenue growth was driven by the LNG terminal segment, which rose 24.7 percent to EUR 18,687 thousand, and the commercial LNG segment, which grew 35.7 percent to EUR 3,357 thousand.

verified_key_information_units.information: Operating activities generated cash flows of EUR 27.9 million in Q1 2026, more than double the EUR 13.5 million recorded in the prior-year period.

candidate_sentences.text: Operating cash flows more than doubled to EUR 27,917 thousand from EUR 13,758 thousand, aided by working capital improvements including the recovery of an EUR 9,642 thousand excess payment to the lending bank recognized in January 2026.

verified_key_information_units.information: Cash and cash equivalents increased to EUR 17.99 million as at 31 March 2026 from EUR 12.36 million as at 31 December 2025.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Consolidated Statements of Cash Flow (page 6) and Statements of Financial Position (page 3)

verified_key_information_units.information: Total borrowings stood at EUR 302.1 million as at 31 March 2026, down slightly from EUR 311.2 million as at 31 December 2025; lease liabilities were EUR 24.6 million.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Borrowings and Lease Liabilities note, Note 9 (page 11)

candidate_sentences.text: Total borrowings declined from EUR 311,194 thousand to EUR 302,069 thousand, supporting the lower financing costs.

verified_key_information_units.information: Subsequent to the reporting period, on 30 April 2026 the Company elected a new independent Board, replacing the previous two-tier governance structure with a unitary Board governance model.
Group EBITDA increased to EUR 16.2 million for Q1 2026 from EUR 13.6 million in Q1 2025.

details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K3, K4, K5, and K7 are PRESENT with clear support in the candidate summary. K6 (cash and cash equivalents) is MISSING - no mention of cash position. K8 (Board governance change) is MISSING - no reference to governance model change. K9 (Group EBITDA) is MISSING - no explicit EBITDA figure provided. The summary captures most high-importance revenue and profit metrics but omits critical liquidity, governance, and profitability indicators, resulting in a mixed coverage level.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent with no material contradictions or logical gaps. All statements build logically upon each other, showing consistent progression from revenue growth through to net profit and cash flow improvements. Explanations for changes (e.g., cost drivers, finance cost reductions) are clearly linked to supporting figures. The structure follows a logical financial narrative from top-line revenue through to bottom-line results and balance sheet changes. While segment figures don't aggregate to the consolidated total (which is normal in financial reporting), the summary never claims they should, so this doesn't constitute an internal contradiction. There is no unnecessary repetition, and all relationships between figures and their explanations are clear and consistent.
